description: This file defines the 'AttendanceProvider' class, a state management provider in a Flutter application that manages attendance data. It interfaces with an 'AttendanceRepository' to fetch and store attendance records, providing methods for marking attendance and loading daily or weekly data.

classes.name: AttendanceProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing attendance state, delegating data persistence to the repository, and notifying listeners on state changes.

methods.name: AttendanceProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider with a required 'AttendanceRepository' instance.

methods.name: daily
methods.description: Getter returning the current list of daily attendance records.

methods.name: markNow
methods.description: Asynchronously records attendance status for a student in the current period, returning true if successful, false otherwise.

methods.name: loadDaily
methods.description: Loads attendance records for a specified date into internal state and notifies listeners.

methods.name: loadWeekly
methods.description: Fetches attendance records for a week starting date without altering internal state, returning a Future list.
